svg.title: Review and merge: review here, merge what you saw
svg.desc: The Nilbox review sheet, a panel over the inbox, open on acme-org/api#212, Add jitter to webhook retry backoff, by alice. On the left, the diff of webhook/backoff.go with a line comment being written on line 16, with Suggest a change, Cancel, and Add to review. On the right, the line that says what it still needs to merge, An approval · auto-merge available, then the reviewers (bob approved, carol awaiting review), the checks (12 checks, 1 running, 11 passed, 3 of them required), and Your review with the one button, Approve & squash-merge, and its menu. Numbered callouts explain line comments checked before GitHub sees them, the line that stays in view, and the one button. An arrow marked ⌘↩ leads from the button to the confirmation every merge asks first: Approve and merge #212 into main?, with the merge methods, At commit 3f9c2a1. GitHub refuses it if anything is pushed first., and Cancel or Approve & squash-merge.

g.text: Read the diff, checks, and reviews in one panel, with one button for the action that fits.
Every merge asks first, pinned to the commit you saw. No agent ever approves or merges.
Add jitter to webhook retry backoff
Could jitter push d past maxDelay?
One line that stays in view, above
The action that fits, the rest in
its menu. And every merge asks first:
